description: BC purchase reader (Production, GET only): per pinned company (Production: My Company only; other listed companies are counted, never read), a PO number seeded from a posted receipt's orderNumber (else the first purchase order), then the order, its lines, posted receipts by orderNumber, invoices by orderNumber and by the order's orderId (unverified GUID filter), all their lines and the item masters of the lines' item Nos. (the reads a scoped completeness claim needs), plus the PO case view. A company with no seed records seed_from none and a seed_reason; a failed seed read records which read and its HTTP status, error-code class and detail token. Counts, statuses, field presence and finding codes only (PO vs invoice unit cost differences as counts); no values.
notes: live-unverified until a passing live-check result. seed_reason no_purchase_documents (receipt and order listings both read, both empty: an empty book) and no_order_number are recorded outcomes, not failures; read_failed and any receipt_seed_error/order_seed_error fail the check. The 82dbb71 run failed on a bare receipt_seed_error=SourceUnavailable in a company whose case_entities read of purchaseReceipts ($top=1, no $select) succeeded empty, while company 0 read purchaseReceipts with $select=number,orderNumber successfully; without_select tells a refused projection (status read) from an outage or throttle (detail retried.http_429/503). Unverified live: purchaseReceipts.orderNumber as filter (Portal outbox-drain.ts@8f566f8:1196 filters orderNumber eq with $orderby postingDate desc, no $select); a 400 shows as unavailable_reads=[purchaseReceipts.orderNumber]. price_pairs (counts only, decision 2026-10-08-bc-three-way-price-basis): each invoice Item line paired with the one PO Item line of its item No. and unit of measure; equal / differ compare the PO line's directUnitCost with the invoice line's unitCost as Decimals, cost_absent where either is not read. differ > 0 is the decision's reversal signal (the two costs are not the same quantity); expected on the next live run: paired >= 0 per company, every count present. Scope: only the company pinned in integrations/bc_company_books.json is read; companies_count must be exactly 1 and pinned_name_mismatch 0 (a pinned GUID listed under a name other than My Company fails closed). companies_listed and out_of_scope_companies are counts only.
